core_obligations: Reduce to an open immersion via Zariski main theorem and the exactness/faithfulness of finite pushforward.

Flat base change to Spec(O_{X,ξ}) and apply the local-cohomology finiteness lemma to reach the algebra problem.
Conclude with the depth lemma: a finite module supported on all of Spec(A) has nonzero local cohomology.
